name: PERTABI
tagline: Persatuan Taat Bersama Isteri Malaysia · Taat Setia Progresif

ownership.text: Persatuan Taat Bersama Isteri Malaysia (PERTABI — PPM-023-10-15122021) is a national-level society registered under Section 7 of the Societies Act 1966, dedicated to advancing husband welfare, family communication, and household health across Malaysia.
